preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = current_schema() AND indexname = 'uk_reservations_lane_timeslot_active'

changeSet.sql: UPDATE reservations SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pool_id, date, heure_debut, heure_fin, COALESCE(numeros_couloirs, CAST(numero_couloir AS VARCHAR), '__POOL__') ORDER BY created_at NULLS LAST, id ) AS row_number FROM reservations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND statut <> 'ANNULEE' ) duplicates WHERE row_number > 1 );

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_reservations_lane_timeslot_active ON reservations ( pool_id, date, heure_debut, heure_fin, COALESCE(numeros_couloirs, CAST(numero_couloir AS VARCHAR), '__POOL__') ) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND statut <> 'ANNULEE';
